title: Local Zoning, Taxis, and Tax Forgiveness
summary:
*   **Significant Zoning Ordinance Update:** The council initiated a process to amend the city's general zoning ordinance, scheduling a public hearing for May 17 to review proposed changes to several sections.
*   **New Taxi Licenses Approved:** Two new taxicab licenses were granted for individuals to operate 1940 and 1942 Chevrolet Sedans as taxis.
*   **Remission of Old Tax Penalties:** Penalties and half of the interest were remitted on long-overdue personal property and real estate taxes for two individuals, with some debts dating back as far as 1931.

(RESOLUTION)
WHEREAS, the City of Austin taxes for the years 1931 through 1941 were assessed in the
name of Dr. G. F. Eckhardt on personal property in the City of Austin, Travis County,

remit said penalty in the sum of $2.67 and one-half of the interest in the sum of $12.76;
therefore BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: THAT the aforesaid
penalty in the sum of $2.67 and one-half of the in terest in the sum of $12.76 are hereby
remitted, and the Tax Assessor and Collector of the City of Austin is hereby authorized
and directed to charge said penalty in the sum of $2.67 and said interest in the sum of
$12.76 off his rolls, and to issue to the party entitled to receive same a receipt in full
upon the payment of the taxes and one-half of the interest as aforesaid. vote: Upon
